overview.mockNotice: Design preview — curator programs, balances, and positions below are mock fixtures. No funds move in this flow.
overview.positionsDescription: Positions are grouped by curator, with individual holdings available when you need them.
overview.positionsEmpty: No managed positions yet. Choose a curator to start earning.
overview.redemptionsDescription: Delayed withdrawals keep the curator first and settle as each underlying liquidity window passes.
overview.curatorsDescription: Choose the team that will build and monitor the earn allocation. Each program keeps its available opportunities visible without making them the primary decision.
overview.programRateDisclosure: APY ranges are variable, fixture-derived estimates shown for comparison only. Actual rates, allocations, and liquidity depend on the funding asset and eligible opportunities.

risk.conservativeDescription: Tokenized money-market funds and short treasuries. Instant liquidity, steadiest yield.
risk.balancedDescription: Blue-chip DeFi lending and short-duration RWAs. Instant to T+2 redemption.
risk.balancedShortDescription: Balances yield, liquidity, and market risk.
risk.enhancedDescription: Higher-yield credit strategies with longer redemption windows.
risk.enhancedShortDescription: Accepts more risk and longer redemption windows.

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.programDescription: Choose a funding wallet and one program-level amount. Curator routing handles the eligible holdings for you.
withdraw.programWalletDescription: Settled funds return to {wallet}; your other custody wallets stay unchanged.
withdraw.programRoutingDescriptionOne: The request will route through the one eligible holding.
withdraw.programRoutingDescriptionMany: The request will be distributed proportionally across {count} eligible holdings.
withdraw.programSettlementDelayed: Each holding keeps its own liquidity terms; some funds may take up to T+{days}.
withdraw.programSettlementInstant: All current holdings are eligible for instant settlement.
withdraw.previewInstantDefiCaveat: Subject to protocol liquidity — full utilization can delay settlement (see strategy terms).
withdraw.previewMixed: {pct}% settles to {wallet} immediately. The remainder becomes available {date}.
withdraw.previewDelayed: Funds become available {date}. This amount stops earning now and settles when the redemption window passes.
withdraw.errorAmountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero.
withdraw.errorBalanceChanged: The available balance changed. Review the updated amount and try again.

wizard.profileDescription: Pick the yield and liquidity trade-off that fits this treasury.
wizard.strategyDescription: Strategies matching your risk profile, with curator and liquidity terms up front.
wizard.amountDescription: Choose the funding wallet, stablecoin, and amount to deposit.
wizard.reviewDescription: Confirm the deposit details before submitting.
wizard.noStrategiesForFilters: No strategies match these filters yet. Adjust the risk profile or curator.
wizard.splitHelp: Pick multiple strategies and set each allocation — the deposit splits across them and must total 100%.
wizard.byokHelp: Bring your own key: SDP builds the transaction and you sign it from your own wallet. Funds never touch an SDP custody account.
wizard.errorAmountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero.
wizard.summaryEmpty: Your selections appear here as you go.
wizard.mockConfirmNote: Design preview: confirming records a mock position locally — no funds move.
wizard.successDescription: Your position is live. Track it from the Earn overview.

setup.walletDescription: Import a Solana wallet from your custody provider. This stays mocked for now.
setup.preferencesDescription: Tell us what matters. Your answers highlight programs with relevant opportunities without hiding any curators.
setup.curatorsDescription: Compare each curator's approach, fit, and available program opportunities. The underlying detail stays optional.
setup.strategiesDescription: Optional detail: review or customize the holdings inside the selected curator program.
setup.allocationDescription: Optionally override curator-managed routing with explicit target weights.
setup.reviewDescription: Confirm the wallet, curator-managed program, and destination before creation.
setup.anchorageDescription: Import a qualified-custody wallet and balances.
setup.walletMockNotice: Design preview only. Provider connections, credentials, and balances are mocked; no custody permissions are requested.
setup.useCaseDescription: Choose where the experience ends. You can change this during review.
setup.destinationTreasuryDescription: Fund a vault directly and track live positions in SDP.
setup.destinationRetailDescription: Preview an embedded experience, then integrate it by API or SDK.
setup.riskQuestionTitle: What should the risk posture be?
setup.riskQuestionDescription: This highlights programs with at least one relevant opportunity; it does not constrain curator routing.
setup.yieldSourceTitle: Which yield sources should we include?
setup.yieldSourceDescription: Advanced: highlight programs with opportunities from the sources you care about.
setup.sourceAllDescription: Compare tokenized assets and DeFi together.
setup.sourceRwaDescription: Tokenized treasuries, money markets, and private credit.
setup.sourceDefiDescription: Onchain lending strategies with transparent liquidity.
setup.preferencesRankCurators: Preferences highlight programs with at least one matching opportunity. They do not hide choices or constrain the curator's eventual allocation.
setup.preferencesAreFilters: Preferences highlight programs rather than hiding choices. You can refine them later.
setup.preferencesDiscoveryOnly: These preferences shape discovery only. The curator controls the eventual allocation within the program, subject to the funding asset and program terms.
setup.whatCuratorDoesDescription: Curators research yield opportunities, define risk limits, and manage allocations for you. They do not control your custody account, and every underlying holding remains visible.
setup.curatorMockNotice: Design preview only. Curator profiles, program ranges, and allocations are mocked and are not recommendations.
setup.opportunityTransparency: These are opportunities the curator may use. Your funding asset determines the eligible initial mix, and you do not need to manage it yourself.
setup.routingTransparency: This is the eligible initial routing for the selected funding asset. The curator manages the allocation after funding.

steakhouse.headline: Liquidity-first treasury management
steakhouse.description: Focuses on tokenized cash and short-duration treasury products, prioritizing access to funds and steadier rates.

gauntlet.headline: Actively managed onchain yield
gauntlet.description: Combines money-market funds, DeFi lending, and credit opportunities with active risk monitoring across a wider return range.
gauntlet.bestFor: Teams balancing liquidity with higher yield

sentora.headline: Focused credit and lending
sentora.description: Runs a smaller, selective set of lending and private-credit opportunities for teams comfortable with more concentration.

default.headline: Curator-managed yield
default.description: Selects and monitors eligible yield opportunities within the program mandate.
default.bestFor: Teams that want a managed allocation

setup.strategyCardLabel: {strategy}. {apy} estimated APY. {risk} risk. {source}. Curated by {curator}. {liquidity}. {tvl} TVL. Funding assets: {assets}.
setup.noResultsDescription: Reset the filters to return to the full mocked catalogue.
setup.positiveWeightsRequired: Give every selected strategy a positive weight.
setup.delegateDescription: Delegate day-to-day weighting across the selected strategies.
setup.customWeightsDescription: Keep direct control of the percentage assigned to each strategy.
setup.mixedRequiresWeightsDescription: Set an explicit allocation because no single curator manages the full program.
setup.delegationSummaryDescription: Preview figures use an even initial estimate. {curator} can rebalance across these {count} strategies while custody stays unchanged.
setup.destinationDescription: Treasury funds the vault directly. Retail hands the experience to end users through your product.
setup.destinationTreasuryReview: Create a vault, then fund it from the imported wallet.
setup.destinationRetailReview: Create a preview and receive an integration configuration.
setup.variableRateDisclosure: Estimated APY is variable and shown for comparison only. Final rates and liquidity depend on the curator's underlying holdings and allocation.
setup.fundVaultDescription: Choose the deposit asset and amount. The curator program routes the mock deposit across eligible holdings.
setup.fundVaultDelegatedDescription: Choose the deposit asset and amount. The preview uses an indicative allocation that the curator can rebalance after funding.
setup.fundCuratorProgramDescription: Choose a funding asset and amount. {curator} manages routing across the program's eligible holdings.
setup.depositDetailsDescription: Funds move from the imported wallet into the vault program.
setup.insufficientBalance: Amount exceeds the available wallet balance.
setup.invalidAmount: Enter an amount of at least 0.01.
setup.depositMockNotice: Mock transaction only. Confirming stores local positions; no transaction is signed or sent.
setup.previewDescription: See how the curator-managed program can appear inside your product before wiring the integration.
setup.previewOnlyNotice: This preview is non-transactional. End-user actions are disabled.
setup.integrateDescription: Use the mocked sandbox configuration to wire the experience into your application.
setup.secureKey: Create a restricted server-side API key.
setup.mountExperience: Mount the Earn experience in your application.
setup.testQuote: Run a sandbox quote before enabling deposits.
setup.vaultLiveDescription: The mock deposit is allocated across the curator program and ready to track from the Earn dashboard.
setup.depositConfirmedDescription: Mock positions were recorded locally. No funds moved and no transaction was sent.
